acceptance.printed_types:
@CurrentMain.RecoveredProviderChart.recover_of_factorization : ∀ {n : ℕ}
  (d : CurrentMain.RecoveredProviderChart.Input n) (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)),
  (∀ (j : Fin n), d.columns j < 2 ^ n) →
    (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.form (CurrentMain.RecoveredProviderChart.candidate d p)) d.updateVector = 0 →
      (∀ (j i : Fin n),
          CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.bits (d.columns j) i =
            Pi.single (p j) 1 i + d.coefficients (p j) * d.updateVector i) →
        ∃ r,
          CurrentMain.RecoveredProviderChart.recover d = some r ∧ ↑r = CurrentMain.RecoveredProviderChart.candidate d p
@CurrentMain.RecoveredProviderChart.recover_sound : ∀ {n : ℕ} (d : CurrentMain.RecoveredProviderChart.Input n)
  (r : CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.Certified n),
  CurrentMain.RecoveredProviderChart.recover d = some r →
    (↑r).columns = d.columns ∧
      (↑r).updateVector = d.updateVector ∧
        (↑r).coefficients = d.coefficients ∧
          CurrentMain.JsonBinaryChartInterpreter.certify 3 n
                (CurrentMain.JsonBinaryChartInterpreter.canonicalJson ↑r ⋯) =
              some r ∧
            CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.sourceLinear ↑r = ↑(CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.checkedEquiv ↑r ⋯) ∧
              (∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
                  CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r)
                      ((CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.sourceLinear ↑r) x) =
                    x) ∧
                ∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
                  (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.sourceLinear ↑r)
                      (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r) x) =
                    x

@CurrentMain.RecoveredJsonProviderEntry.recoverEntry_complete : ∀ {n : ℕ} (dictionary : Lean.Json) (key : String)
  (cols : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.Columns n) (c : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Candidate n)
  (h : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.check c = true)
  (hc : c.columns = CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.columnFunction cols),
  CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.dictionaryColumns n dictionary key = some cols →
    CurrentMain.RecoveredJsonProviderEntry.recoverEntry n dictionary key c.updateVector c.coefficients =
      some { columns := cols, certificate := ⟨c, h⟩, column_match := ⋯ }
@CurrentMain.RecoveredJsonProviderEntry.recoverEntry_sound : ∀ {n : ℕ} (dictionary : Lean.Json) (key : String)
  (update coefficients : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n)
  (r : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.CheckedEntry n),
  CurrentMain.RecoveredJsonProviderEntry.recoverEntry n dictionary key update coefficients = some r →
    (∃ raw,
        dictionary.getObjVal? key = Except.ok raw ∧
          CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2
              (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue r.columns) =
            raw) ∧
      CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns =
          ↑(CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.checkedEquiv ↑r.certificate ⋯) ∧
        (∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
            CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate)
                ((CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns) x) =
              x) ∧
          ∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
            (CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns)
                (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate) x) =
              x

@CurrentMain.ByteJsonGlobalCall.assignedBytes_sound : ∀ {n m k : ℕ} {ρ : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} (fuel : ℕ)
  (routeDecoder : CurrentMain.SelectedSourceSyntax.Value → Option ρ) (assignment : Fin k → Fin m → Fin n)
  (store : Fin n → α) (bytes : ByteArray) (position : Fin k)
  (r : CurrentMain.JsonOwnerFieldAdapter.Matched n m routeDecoder (assignment position)),
  CurrentMain.ByteJsonGlobalCall.assignedBytes fuel n m k routeDecoder assignment bytes position = some r →
    (∃ text global calls call raw,
        String.fromUTF8? bytes = some text ∧
          Lean.Json.parse text = Except.ok global ∧
            global.getObjVal? "calls" = Except.ok (Lean.Json.arr calls) ∧
              calls.size = k ∧
                (∃ (hi : ↑position < calls.size), calls[↑position] = call) ∧
                  CurrentMain.JsonOwnerFieldAdapter.callOwners fuel n routeDecoder call = some ↑r ∧
                    call.getObjVal? "owners" = Except.ok raw ∧
                      CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode fuel
                          (CurrentMain.SelectedSourceSyntax.Value.array
                            (List.map CurrentMain.JsonOwnerFieldAdapter.rowValue ↑r)) =
                        raw) ∧
      CurrentMain.ByteJsonGlobalCall.gatherBytes fuel routeDecoder store bytes position =
        some (List.ofFn fun i => store (assignment position i))

@CurrentMain.ByteRecoveredProviderEntry.recoverBytes_complete : ∀ {n : ℕ} (bytes : ByteArray) (text : String)
  (dictionary : Lean.Json) (key : String) (cols : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.Columns n)
  (c : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Candidate n) (h : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.check c = true)
  (hc : c.columns = CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.columnFunction cols),
  String.fromUTF8? bytes = some text →
    Lean.Json.parse text = Except.ok dictionary →
      CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.dictionaryColumns n dictionary key = some cols →
        CurrentMain.ByteRecoveredProviderEntry.recoverBytes n bytes key c.updateVector c.coefficients =
          some { columns := cols, certificate := ⟨c, h⟩, column_match := ⋯ }
@CurrentMain.ByteRecoveredProviderEntry.recoverBytes_sound : ∀ {n : ℕ} (bytes : ByteArray) (key : String)
  (update coefficients : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n)
  (r : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.CheckedEntry n),
  CurrentMain.ByteRecoveredProviderEntry.recoverBytes n bytes key update coefficients = some r →
    (∃ text dictionary raw,
        String.fromUTF8? bytes = some text ∧
          Lean.Json.parse text = Except.ok dictionary ∧
            CurrentMain.RecoveredJsonProviderEntry.recoverEntry n dictionary key update coefficients = some r ∧
              dictionary.getObjVal? key = Except.ok raw ∧
                CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2
                    (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue r.columns) =
                  raw) ∧
      CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns =
          ↑(CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.checkedEquiv ↑r.certificate ⋯) ∧
        (∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
            CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate)
                ((CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns) x) =
              x) ∧
          ∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
            (CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns)
                (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate) x) =
              x

scope.result: Finite recovery constructs the checked permutation/inverse and canonical certificate from packed columns plus update/form; named dictionary and byte entrypoints preserve actual input equations and derive the independent binary column operator and both inverses.
scope.dimension: All recovery/chart results quantify over arbitrary natural dimension n, including the empty finite dimension. They do not assert efficient execution uniformly in n. Calls/owners entry is additionally parameterized by family, row and call counts and arbitrary payload type.
scope.restricted_class: Completeness requires one involutive rank-one update after a coordinate permutation: packed-column bounds, form(update)=0, and exact scalar entries. Arbitrary invertibility alone is insufficient. A proof-side Candidate specifies this class; it is not passed to recovery execution.
scope.source_inputs: Runtime inputs are the original bytes or immutable dictionary AST, an exact key, and update/form vectors. The checker constructs auxiliary certificate data; no inverse table, supplied permutation or desired operator equality is an executable premise.
scope.parser: Byte success exposes String.fromUTF8? and Lean.Json.parse equations for the original bytes. This is compositional soundness relative to the installed functions, not Unicode/JSON standards verification.
scope.failure: Malformed input or failed recovery returns none in consumers; the underlying parseBytes API preserves distinct invalid-UTF8 and invalid-JSON errors.
not_claimed: success on any selected artifact or a full selected table census
cryptographic digest/key authenticity or byte-to-repository provenance
lexical integer-only policy, duplicate-key rejection or canonical serializer round trip
complex phases, affine shifts or physical chart/payload direction
physical allocation, primitive executor, precision or runtime/bit-cost bound
full multiplication theorem or a change to kappa
